long_biography.plain_text:
Culver entered media through film production before moving into advertising. After helping establish a charitable lottery in Britain, he held a senior sales role at transit advertiser TDI and soon afterward founded Culver Media Group. Those experiences in place-based advertising prepared him to co-found Health Media Network with Paul Theisen in 2007.

The new company delivered health education and advertising through digital screens, wallboards and other media inside medical practices. Culver led it as president and chief executive, expanding through acquisitions, technology partnerships and outside financing before its 2022 sale to CheckedUp. Beyond business, he built a sustained competitive-sailing record and served in senior governance roles at prominent American sailing organisations.
